passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
DatabaseBackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Ref KeyDescription
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: !If [IsMultiRegion, true, false]
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref PendingWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowRDSServiceGrant
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: 'true'
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceGrant
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: 'true'
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref KeyAlias
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DatabaseBackups
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: SecurityLevel
          Value: High
